from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-0eb170c9.py'
program_text='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    if not points:
        return out
    center_r = sum(r for r, c in points) / len(points)
    center_c = sum(c for r, c in points) / len(points)
    colors = {}
    for r, c in points:
        colors.setdefault(grid[r][c], set()).add((r, c))
    for color, cells in colors.items():
        if len(cells) < 2:
            continue
        for r, c in cells:
            dr = (r > center_r) - (r < center_r)
            dc = (c > center_c) - (c < center_c)
            if dr == dc == 0:
                continue
            # Continue outward only from a tip whose same-color predecessor points inward.
            if (r - dr, c - dc) not in cells:
                continue
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_text)
print(program_path)
